subject.title: Bug: Poe image/video-output models are accepted in config but fail at runtime (Nano Banana 400, Veo/Sora fallback)

question: Should configured chat/session model catalogs grow an output-modality contract, or should media-output model refs be rejected and routed only through image_generate/video_generate provider capabilities for now?
rationale: Current code has separate chat-model and media-generation capability paths, and choosing between explicit rejection versus first-class media-output chat models affects plugin API, config schema, fallback behavior, and channel delivery.

options.title: Reject unsupported chat media-output refs now
options.body: Add clear validation/runtime diagnostics and docs that image/video-output generation belongs to image_generate/video_generate until an output-modality contract is designed.

options.title: Design full output-modality support
options.body: Extend model config/catalogs, provider routing, response payloads, and channel delivery so selected chat models can intentionally return generated media.

options.title: Track only input-modality fixes separately
options.body: Let the open input-modality work proceed while keeping this issue open for the distinct output-model contract decision.

recommendation.title: Reject unsupported chat media-output refs now
recommendation.body: Add clear validation/runtime diagnostics and docs that image/video-output generation belongs to image_generate/video_generate until an output-modality contract is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans model runtime and media-generation boundaries that recent history most strongly associates with steipete's work.
